install_note: Python packages go in their own environment at ~/.venvs/colorgrade, never in the bot's .venv: python3 -m venv ~/.venvs/colorgrade && ~/.venvs/colorgrade/bin/pip install numpy pillow scipy scenedetect opencv-python-headless (about 300 MB). Licences: numpy BSD-3, scipy BSD-3, pillow MIT-CMU, PySceneDetect BSD-3, OpenCV Apache-2.0. All clean for paid client work. The object isolation track additionally wants DaVinci Resolve installed to receive the DCTL, but the DCTL is written and proved with no Resolve involved.
